name: The Radio Wave Bureau
source:
On that cold new year's eve the computer got sick. The underfunded Radio Wave Bureau refuses to lend a hand and work has to continue. People need to be known, choices have to be undone.

[From [url=https://4331pro.itch.io/the-radio-wave-bureau]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在那个寒冷的除夕夜，电脑出问题了。资金不足的无线电波局拒绝伸出援手，工作必须继续进行。人们需要被了解，选择必须被撤销。

[来自[url=https://4331pro.itch.io/the-radio-wave-bureau]Itch.io[/url]]
